macros.name: rcsInfoDate
macros.doc: The date in the form YYYY/MM/DD, when the file was checked out.

macros.name: rcsInfoLocker
macros.doc: If the file is locked, the user name of the locker. If the file is not locked: --not-locked--.

macros.name: rcsInfoOwner
macros.doc: The user name of the file owner.

macros.name: rcsInfoRevision
macros.doc: The RCS revision number, of the checked out file.

macros.name: rcsInfoStatus
macros.doc: The stautus of the file, e.g. Exp.

macros.name: rcsInfoTime
macros.doc: The time, when the file was checked out.
